name: What is a backyard tiny home?
description: A backyard tiny home is a self-contained secondary dwelling on a residential property, offering flexible uses like guest housing or rental income.

mainEntity.name: What is a backyard tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A backyard tiny home, also known as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), is a secondary residential structure on a property with an existing single-family home. These units are self-contained with their own living, sleeping, kitchen, and bathroom facilities. They offer flexible uses, such as housing for family members, rental income, or a dedicated workspace. Zen Tiny Homes specializes in designing and building these units to maximize functionality within a compact footprint.
